en: Black‑and‑white view along a tree‑lined urban street with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century residential and commercial row houses. The buildings have steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, and stepped or curved gables typical of German architecture of that era. Shop signs are visible at street level on several façades. One clearly readable sign on the nearest corner building says "Kaiserl…", likely referring to a business named after the Kaiser. A single pedestrian walks along the wide sidewalk at the lower right.
